test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

I have already paid him more than ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enough"** is used to indicate sufficiency or adequacy.
 
• In the context of the sentence,** "enough"** appropriately completes the idea that the speaker has paid a sufficient amount.
 
• Other options such as** "complete," "halves," and "full" **do not fit logically or grammatically in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I have already paid him more than **enough**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Complete:** This word does not fit logically in the context of the sentence.
 
• **Halves:** This word is plural and does not fit grammatically in the context of the sentence.
 
• **Full:** This word does not fit logically in the context of the sentence.
